reviewer: sf2_semantics_review agent (static comparison against sealed SF9/SF8/SF2)
scope: Static review of SF10 CONTROLLER/CURRICULUM/PREFLIGHT/BUILD/LAUNCH/REPORTER against the sealed SF9 CONTROLLER and frozen SF2_ENGINE, focused on the single reduced-exposure manipulation.
findings: SF10 CONTROLLER.py preserves SF9's objective verbatim: factual full-vocab CE over answer+EOS + lambda=1.0 KL + lambda_margin=0.25 * mean(max(0, 1.0-gap)) on the first answer name token, constant English LR 5e-5, unchanged optimizer/scope/binding/KL. The curriculum content is byte-for-byte identical to SF9's 144 items (verified by CURRICULUM.py and independently re-verified in PREFLIGHT.py against SF9's own TRAIN.json), with a deterministic 'shard' tag (0-3) added, derived only from pre-existing structural identifiers (TRAIN16 pair_id; new-item group+verb+objectkey), never from any observed outcome. Each English update now trains one 36-item balanced shard (name-answer 9/9/9/9, each surface 4 items, each order:query subgroup 4 items) instead of SF9's full 144, cycled 0,1,2,3 across the 180 English updates (45 full rotations; per-item exposure 45x vs SF9's 180x). Parents are the three SF8 lambda=0.25 checkpoints (explicitly NOT the D3-polluted SF9 checkpoints, verified by path assertion in PREFLIGHT). Development panels (TRAIN16_RETENTION, DEV_SURFACE, DEV_ORDER) are byte-identical reuses of SF9's own files, and PROTOCOL.json documents them as historical development rulers (already observed once in SF9), not pristine holdouts. Gates are re-confirmed byte-for-byte against the sealed SF9 PROTOCOL.json before freezing. No margin/M/KL/scope/optimizer/tokenizer change. Frozen SF1 transfer panels are not referenced anywhere in the training source.
limitations: N=3 parent replications; no population claim. This is one bounded density treatment, not a sweep - no second density arm exists to compare against.
mechanical_hygiene_review: REPORTER.py's classification logic is factored into a standalone classify() function and its file-loading logic into load_trajectory(), both smoke-tested against a synthetic fixture (REPORTER_SMOKE_TEST.py) BEFORE this review/seal, specifically covering the exact SF9 post-hoc bug (missing update0_GATES.json) and multiple classification scenarios. PREFLIGHT.py re-runs the smoke test as a gate. LAUNCH.py runs each of the three CONTROLLER invocations exactly once, sequentially, via blocking subprocess.run (no detached/background processes), and writes an explicit RUN_LEDGER.json. REPORTER.py/REPORTER_SMOKE_TEST.py are included in the sealed manifest and will not be modified after SEAL.
root_addendum: Confirmed the shard/exposure design is the single manipulated variable and was fixed by the curriculum's own structure (144/4=36) before any run; no density sweep occurred and none is planned within this study.
